name: Anamika High Point
usps: Features 31-storey iconic towers offering unobstructed, panoramic views of the S.G. Highway and Sindhu Bhavan Road.
Offers an expansive 70,000 sq.ft. podium living space on the 1st floor featuring 30+ ultra-modern club-class amenities.
Spacious 3-side open apartments designed for optimal sunlight, ventilation, and Vastu compliance.
Provides up to 4 allotted car parking spaces per residence across a 3-level basement layout.
Wind tunnel tested structure by RWDI, integrated with 5 high-speed, spacious elevators per block and access-controlled lobbies.
amenities: Swimming pool, splash pool, and dedicated deck area.
Tennis/pickleball court, box cricket, and indoor sports area.
Fully-equipped gymnasium, yoga/pilates studio, and walking track.
Two mini-theatres, virtual gaming area, and sports café.
Steam & sauna, salon, and therapy room.
Banquet hall with lawn, exclusive lounge, and terrace garden.
Toddler area, kids' play zone with rock-climbing wall, and day care space.
Car wash area, driver's lounge, and EV car charging provision in the common basement.
target_audience: Affluent families, business owners, and senior executives seeking ultra-luxury, high-rise 4 & 5 BHK residences in the prime commercial and lifestyle hub of Ahmedabad (S.G. Highway / Sindhu Bhavan Road).
tagline: A Symphony of Luxury, Lifestyle & Iconic Location Unveiled
project_size: 31 Storeys, 5 Blocks (A, B, C, D, E)
